scope: Section command, CPlane trace, property/group output and exact topological mesh slicing

workspace_release_tests.verification: Complete core/oracle groups passed; the new integration test was rerun successfully after correcting an integer-versus-float JSON assertion. Required doctests then passed.

native_engine: Rhino 8.32.26160.13001 x86-64 through ARM64 Wine/FEX on private Xvfb
plane_contract: Project picked trace direction into the current CPlane; use CPlane Z as the other in-plane direction. ExtendSection=No clips to the picked span. Degenerate traces are rejected before output admission.
input_contract: Curves, NURBS surfaces, B-reps and meshes; point/cloud-only selection is rejected. Source geometry stays intact; unsupported downstream intersection families fail without partial output.
output_contract: Per-source Section outputs stage before document admission; ByCurrentLayer creates fresh attributes and ByInputObject copies input attributes. Optional grouping collects one plane output. Repeated viewport planes use the shared two-point drafting pipeline and local one-step history per accepted plane. All currently produces curves/points because section style/hatch support is absent.
mesh_contract: Exact dyadic plane distances and edge intersections round shared world endpoints once. Vertex/edge keys connect adjacent triangles; directed segments follow input face winding. Coplanar face interiors cancel internal triangle edges. Tracing stops at junctions; finite spans clip polyline segments.
comparison_limits: Thirteen strict sampled output/domain/metadata/group recipes match. The coplanar mesh output has the correct rectangular boundary, while Rhino emits two extra collinear vertices and a different seam/domain; the raw report remains failed for that one recipe. Its native polyline vertices were captured in a separate owned detail experiment with the public TryGetPolyline API. This is not an all-input compatibility certificate.
remaining_scope: Coplanar/closed mesh seam and parameter-domain fidelity
Broader NURBS/B-rep families and nonmanifold junction policies
Native selection/history fidelity and performance/GPU measurement
verification_note: The initial full run failed only at the new diagnostic assertion comparing JSON [0.0,4.0] to [0,4]. Final implementation tests, corrected integration and workspace doctests pass. The raw native replay still retains one coplanar mesh diagnostic.
